label: ESG strategy and roadmap
example: We need an ESG roadmap and governance structure for our Asian sourcing operation.

label: Carbon accounting and decarbonisation
example: We need Scope 1–3 or product carbon-footprint support and a reduction plan.

label: CBAM calculation and reporting
example: We export CBAM-covered products to the EU and need calculation and reporting support.

label: Digital Product Passport and product traceability
example: We need to prepare product data and identifiers for an EU Digital Product Passport.

label: Technical documentation and product information
example: We need help preparing technical files, manuals or product information for EU requirements.

label: ESG reporting and assurance
example: We need ESG/CSRD reporting, controls or independent assurance.

label: Supply-chain due diligence
example: We need supplier risk mapping, audits or CSDDD/LkSG implementation support.

label: Human rights and social compliance
example: We need social audits, human-rights due diligence or grievance-process support.

label: Testing, inspection and certification
example: We need independent testing, inspection, certification or verification.

label: Sustainable product and packaging compliance
example: We need help with ecodesign, packaging, chemicals, repairability or product claims.

label: Circular economy, waste and recycling
example: We need recycling, waste reduction or circular product/packaging solutions.

label: Renewable energy and energy efficiency
example: We need renewable energy, energy-efficiency or smart-building solutions.

label: Sustainable logistics and transport
example: We need logistics emissions data or lower-carbon transport options.

label: Green finance and sustainable investment
example: We need green loans, transition finance or sustainability-linked funding.

label: ESG data, software and analytics
example: We need software for ESG data, supplier data, traceability or workflow management.

label: Training and capability building
example: We need ESG training for management, staff or suppliers.

label: Legal and regulatory advice
example: We need advice on EU, German or Hong Kong ESG obligations and green claims.

label: Sustainable materials and product design
example: We need lower-impact materials, LCA, circular design or sustainable packaging.

label: Community impact and employee engagement
example: We need employee engagement, donations or credible community-impact programmes.
